p: hath a controversy with the inhabitants: Because the people would not obey the admonitions of the Prophets, he accuses them before the judgment seat of God, against whom they chiefly offended; Isa 7:13 Zec 12:10; Mic 6:1,2.
blood toucheth blood: In every place appears a liberality to most wicked vices, so that one follows right after another.

let no man strive: As though he would say that it was in vain to rebuke them, for no man can endure it: indeed, they will speak against the prophets and priests whose office it is chiefly to rebuke them.
day: You will both perish together as one, because the former would not obey, and the other, because he would not admonish.
mother: That is, the synagogue in which you boast.
thou hast rejected knowledge: That is, the priests will be cast off, because for lack of knowledge they are not able to execute their charge, and instruct others; De 33:3, Mal 2:7.
thou hast forgotten the law of: Meaning the whole body of the people, who were weary with hearing the word of God.
increased: The more I was beneficial to them.
They eat up the sin of: That is, the priests seek to eat the people's offerings, and flatter them in their sins.
priest: Signifying that as they have sinned together, so will they be punished together.
commit whoredom: Showing that their wickedness will be punished in all ways: for even though they think by the multitude of wives to have many children, yet they will be deceived of their hope.
Whoredom and wine and new wine: In giving themselves to pleasures, they become like brute beasts.

people ask counsel at their stocks: Thus he speaks by derision in calling them his people, who now because of their sins they were not his people: for they sought help from stocks or wooden images and sticks or idols.
spirit of whoredoms hath caused them: They are carried away with madness.
commit whoredom: Because they take away God's honour, and give it to idols: therefore he will give them up to their lusts, so that they will dishonour their own bodies; Ro 1:28.
punish your daughters when they commit: I will not correct your shame to bring you to proper living, but will let you run headlong to your own damnation.
let not Judah offend: God complains that Judah is infected, and wants them to learn to return in time.
Gilgal: For even though the Lord had honoured this place by his presence, yet because it was abused by their idolatry, he did not want his people to resort there.

Bethaven: He calls Bethel, that is, the house of God, Bethaven, that is, the house of iniquity, because of their abominations set up there, signifying that no place is holy, where God is not purely worshipped.
lamb in a large place: God will so disperse them, that they will not remain in any certain place.
Give ye: They are so shameless in receiving bribes, that they command men to bring them to them.
bound her up in her wings: To carry them suddenly away.
